Their mission will be to knock out the generator so our attack can proceed."
"They'll need to begin their operation before our fleet arrives. How will we get them there undetected?|Veertag questions Madine's plan|''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]''}} '''Veertag''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[General]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. He was present for the [[Royal Award Ceremony]] held for the heroes of the [[Battle of Yavin]] in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]], before the Alliance's [[Evacuation of Yavin 4|evacuation]] of the world. Veertag also attended a meeting between members of the Alliance leadership on the [[planet]] [[Zastiga]] to discuss the Empire's construction of a [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] above the moon [[Endor]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|We plant false information about a new principal base—"
"Actually, that wasn't what I was thinking, General. At all."
"It's been a successful gambit before…|Veertag's suggestion is shot down by Organa|}} Veertag was a [[Color|fair-skinned]] [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[General]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. Following the Alliance's victory at the [[Battle of Yavin]], he attended an [[Royal Award Ceremony|award ceremony]] held in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]], honoring the actions of the Rebel heroes [[Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]]. Immediately after the conclusion of the ceremony, all Alliance personnel [[Evacuation of Yavin 4|evacuated]] Yavin 4 in order to avoid the inevitable Imperial counterattack following the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]].[[Princess Leia 1|''Princess Leia'' 1]] [[File:Leia-Han-Share-Look.png|thumb|left|245px|General Veertag looks on at Princess Leia Organa and Han Solo during the award ceremony.]] Shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth]], he was amongst a number of the Alliance's leaders who attended a highly classified meeting in a [[Rebel safe house]] on the [[planet]] [[Zastiga]] concerning the discovery that a second [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star]] was being built by the Empire above the [[moon]] [[Endor]]. At the meeting, the general questioned [[General]] [[Crix Madine]] on how the Alliance could get a team of [[commando]]s onto the moon to disable the Death Star's [[Deflector shield generator|shield generator]]. He then suggested that false information be planted to suggest the Alliance had a new principal base which could act as a decoy for the Empire; however, [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] dismissed the idea and instead proposed that she lead a false recruiting [[Operation Yellow Moon|mission]] to the [[Corva sector]], where she would draw the Empire's attention as a moving target. Organa's plan was ultimately approved and carried out successfully, aiding in the Alliance's eventual victory at the [[Battle of Endor]]. ==Behind the scenes== Veertag was first created for the ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Star Wars (1977) 65|''Star Wars'' (1977) 65]], which was released by [[Marvel Comics]] in [[1982]].[[Star Wars (1977) 65|''Star Wars'' (1977) 65]] He then went on to be given the first name "[[Duron Veertag|Duron]]" by author [[Jason Fry]] in the ''Legends'' sourcebook ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'',''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' who then established with [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Leland Chee]] that Veertag was one of the unnamed Rebels present for the Royal Award Ceremony shown in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/25851092826/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-13|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 13|archivedate=20150423050317}} through the [[Rogues Gallery (Star Wars Insider)|Rogues Gallery]] article in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 133|133]].{{InsiderCite|133|Rogues Gallery (Star Wars Insider)|Rogues Gallery: Celebrating a Rebel Victory!}} Veertag's surname was confirmed to be [[canon]] in [[2015]] by the novel ''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]'', which was written by Fry and [[Cecil Castellucci]]. ==Appearances== *''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} *''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]'' {{Ab|Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure (audiobook)}} {{1stID|Veertag}} *[[Han Solo -
